evals.name: draws-a-project
evals.prompt: Draw the architecture of this project for the README.
evals.expected_output: docs/diagrams/<name>.archgram.yaml passes `archgram check`, and <name>.svg is drawn beside it. It has the API, Postgres, the Redis cache, the orders queue and the worker, each backed by a file in src/ and named in the report with it; a flow follows an order from the API through the queue to the worker and Postgres. The colours come from src/styles.css through archgram.theme.json at the root, with the icons in the text colour. The skill did not ask any question.

evals.name: asks-when-unclear
evals.prompt: Make me an architecture diagram of this service.
evals.expected_output: The README says orders go through Kafka to a billing service, but the code has no Kafka and no billing service. The skill asks the user which is true before drawing either, and does not draw Kafka or billing as if they existed.

evals.name: updates-an-existing-diagram
evals.prompt: The code changed, update the architecture diagram.
evals.expected_output: The skill changes docs/diagrams/architecture.archgram.yaml rather than starting a new spec: it keeps the reader, the API and Postgres, adds Elasticsearch and the search call backed by src/api.ts, draws architecture.svg, and says in the report what changed.

evals.name: not-for-other-work
evals.prompt: Add a unit test for the /products route in src/api.ts.
evals.expected_output: The skill is not used: the request is a test, not a diagram. No docs/diagrams folder is created.
